question: True or false: when onShellReady fires, every Suspense boundary has finished loading.
say: True or false? When on shell ready fires, every Suspense boundary has finished loading.
explanation: onShellReady fires once the shell is rendered. Components in nested Suspense boundaries might still be loading data, and stream in later.
explainSay: False. It fires when the shell is ready. Nested boundaries may still be loading.
